# Creately

> Creately is a cloud-based visual collaboration and diagramming platform enabling teams to create, collaborate, and share diagrams in real-time with AI-powered generation capabilities.

Creately offers comprehensive diagramming tools including flowcharts, org charts, mind maps, ER diagrams, network diagrams, and whiteboards with enterprise-grade security (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR compliance). The platform integrates with popular tools like Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Confluence, and provides both cloud and on-premise deployment options.

## Key Topics

- Visual Collaboration
- AI Diagram Generator
- Real-time Editing
- Diagramming Tools
- Flowcharts
- Mind Maps
